question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.
sql:
-- Show all 20 rows
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start
    FROM first_terms
    WHERE CAST(first_term_start AS DATE) >= '1917-01-01' AND CAST(first_term_start AS DATE) <= '1999-12-31'
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM cohort
),
years AS (
    SELECT 1 AS year_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
check_dates AS (
    SELECT c.id_bioguide, c.first_term_start, y.year_num,
           CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.first_term_start AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) + y.year_num AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS dec31_date
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years y
)
SELECT cd.year_num,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
           WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide 
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST(cd.dec31_date AS DATE)
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= CAST(cd.dec31_date AS DATE)
           ) THEN cd.id_bioguide END) / cs.total AS retention_rate
FROM check_dates cd
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
GROUP BY cd.year_num, cs.total
ORDER BY cd.year_num

               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= CAST(cd.dec31_date AS DATE)
           ) THEN cd.id_bioguide END) AS still_in_office
FROM check_dates cd
